name: Employee COI Declaration
subject: Conflict of Interest (COI) Declaration - {{ doc.employee_name }} ({{ doc.name }})
response_html:
Dear {{ doc.first_name or doc.employee_name }},

Welcome to Vodafone Qatar. As part of your onboarding, please complete the Conflict of Interest (COI) Declaration attached to this email.

  1. Open the attached form and fill in every section (your details, spouse/fiancé, children, and any first-degree relatives working with Vodafone Qatar, its vendors, partners or competitors).
  2. Sign and date the form.
  3. Reply to this same email with the signed copy attached (PDF or a clear scan/photo).
Employee ID{{ doc.name }}
Name{{ doc.employee_name }}
Designation{{ doc.designation or "-" }}
Department{{ doc.department or "-" }}
Date of Joining{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.date_of_joining) if doc.date_of_joining else "-" }}

Please reply within 5 working days. If you have any questions, reply to this email and HR Operations will help you.

Regards,
HR Operations
Vodafone Qatar
